  (6371 * ACOS(
    COS(RADIANS(41.8319)) * COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(longitude) - RADIANS(-87.6847)) +
    SIN(RADIANS(41.8319)) * SIN(RADIANS(latitude))
  )) AS distance_km

WHERE (6371 * ACOS(
    COS(RADIANS(41.8319)) * COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(longitude) - RADIANS(-87.6847)) +
    SIN(RADIANS(41.8319)) * SIN(RADIANS(latitude))
  )) <= 50
ORDER BY distance_km", "preview_rows": 50}
